items.t: Stanley Black & Decker (SWK) Connects Online And Store Tool Orders In South Korea
items.sum: Stanley Black & Decker (NYSE:SWK) expanded its use of Anchanto's Order Management System to South Korea to link store and online tool sales. The system now connects digital orders with physical retail inventory for Stanley Black & Decker's South Korean tool distribution network.
